_what: Activation patching. Fraction of the style effect restored by transplanting the last-position hidden state from the fluent run into the struggling run, at each layer.
_model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (24 layers) — CPU run. NOT the 1.5B used for the baseline.
_n: 8 scenarios x 3 phrasings = 24 items per dimension
_finding: Flat at ~0 through layer 11, then a single step at layer 14 carrying 85-90% of the effect, identical across all three dimensions tested.
_OUTSTANDING: No placebo control yet. Late layers restore more by construction. Run archive/dialense_patching_v2.py to test whether layer 14 is style-specific or just this model's general commitment point. Also needs rerunning on 1.5B.
